card.name: Opening bracket before 'see' cross-references
card.fires_on: The opening square bracket that comes right after the end of a sentence or clause in drug-label text, where a cross-reference such as 'see Warnings and Precautions (5.x)' follows.

modes.label: After warning statements
modes.description: Bracket after a statement about a risk or restriction, leading to a 'see Boxed Warning' or 'see Warnings and Precautions' reference.
